faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.how_a: TF2deal.com is a Team Fortress 2 trading website. You can trade your items for our items.
faq.limits_a: Currently you can trade a maximum of 10 items on each side. Pure up to 550 keys, 2 keys worth of refs, 27 recs & 18 scraps.
faq.pure_q: Can I trade items for pure?
faq.pure_a_html: Yes, if there is enough pure on the other side of the trade. You can also get mixed (pure & items).
faq.money_a_html: No, we don't support real world money transactions. No balance either!
faq.deposits_a_html: No, we would never ask you to deposit your items.
faq.refunds_a_html: No. All trades are final once confirmed. Always make sure a trade offer includes the right items.
faq.legit_a_html: I'm aware of a scam that used the domain tf2deal.com in the past {link}. I found out after buying the domain, and I liked the name too much to change it. So yes, this tf2deal.com is legit.
faq.owner_a: The site is run by a single person: Nikolas Malík (me). A passionate TF2 player, trader and self-taught web developer based in Czechia (Central Europe).

about.intro: tf2deal.com is a Team Fortress 2 trading site providing fair and reliable item trades between users and our bots. I dreamed of building an automated trading website back in autumn 2020, and since then I've been working on my programming skills in my free time to make it happen.
about.how_intro: Ways to use the site to trade your items:
about.how_trade: Wait for your inventory to load, select the items you want to trade and click the TRADE button.
about.how_items: If you want to trade a specific item (e.g. Tour of Duty Ticket).
about.how_bptf: Visit the backpack.tf listings of any bot and send a trade offer (or request one) according to the current listings.
about.community_intro: You can join a variety of community activities! Here are some:
about.bots_intro: List of the Steam bots associated with this website. You can send a valid trade offer and the bot will act on it once available, if there is a backpack.tf listing for that item.
about.beware_text: Don't trust anyone who isn't listed here but claims to be part of the website.
